executiveSummary: This week’s organic work included content planning, backlink follow-up, two website enquiry notifications and a recurring monthly review meeting. The prepared website repair package remains a carry-forward priority. GEO optimization was confirmed before this reporting period and remains part of the organic scope. No paid-media results or recommendations are included.

work.title: Content ideas queued and backlink review followed up
work.detail: Additional blog ideas were added to the shared content sheet. The team also reported that a backlink set sent the prior week was still awaiting third-party review. Publication or backlink placement is not established by that update.
work.whyItMatters: Keeps upcoming content and off-site work tied to an identifiable next action.

work.title: Two website enquiry notifications recorded
work.detail: Two distinct website enquiry notifications were recorded in the reviewed correspondence and distributed to the client and account team. Personal enquiry details are excluded from this report.
work.whyItMatters: Creates a concrete follow-up queue; qualification and estimate outcomes still need confirmation.

work.title: Recurring monthly client call established
work.detail: A recurring Fagan and Momentum monthly call was created for the third Thursday, 14:30 to 15:30 Eastern, with the client address and the Momentum account team on the invitation.
work.whyItMatters: Gives the organic programme a standing review rhythm instead of ad hoc check-ins.

decisions.decision: A recurring monthly review call was established for the third Thursday, 2:30 to 3:30 p.m. Eastern.

nextSteps.title: Publish and verify the prepared site fixes
nextSteps.detail: Carry forward the FAQ, location detail, crawl access, spelling and contractor markup repairs from the August package.

nextSteps.title: Connect enquiries to landing pages and estimates
nextSteps.detail: Match website enquiry records to their source pages and subsequent estimate outcomes.

nextSteps.title: Select the next content batch
nextSteps.detail: Choose the next blogs from the shared ideas sheet and confirm the backlink review status.

caveats: Two enquiry notifications are not a count of qualified leads, appointments or won work.
No live publication of the prepared repair package or new backlink placements is established in this period.
